6.334 rsInvalidNestedDataSetAggregate
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidNestedDataSetAggregate is a critical error that occurs when an aggregate function that is
nested inside the Expression parameter to another aggregate function has a Scope parameter that
refers to the name of a dataset.
